requirements.summary: Title may become an evidence candidate only if present in cached metadata.
Mediatype may become an evidence candidate only if present in cached metadata.
Creator, date, and description may become candidates only when present and labeled as source-provided.
File-list metadata may become a candidate observation, not proof of availability.
Checksums and file metadata may become candidates and require review before trust.
IA identifiers and locators may become source locator candidates.
No IA metadata field becomes accepted Eureka truth without review.
